data.narrative:
Cascade Space is a seed-stage space & aerospace company founded by Jacob Portukalian and Arlen Abraham that has raised $5.9M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of 6 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Of three valuation methods examined, only stage-progression proved applicable. Using the $5.9M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields $15M. Peer-median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient same- or adjacent-stage comparables within the space & aerospace sector (only 1 same-stage peer identified; minimum 3 required for statistical reliability). Public-comp anchoring could not be executed because the target's revenue is not disclosed—a constraint endemic to private company valuation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, with a median of $15M, derived from a single method. Key uncertainties include the applicability of a 2.5x step-up multiplier absent closer peer benchmarking, the lack of revenue visibility for cross-sectional P/S anchoring, and the limited depth of the comparable dataset. A fuller valuation would benefit from either access to revenue or customer metrics, or identification of additional seed-stage space companies with disclosed financials.
